# Cached data for Quran 1:5

## Arabic (Uthmani)
إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ

## Khattab — The Clear Quran
"You ˹alone˺ we worship and You ˹alone˺ we ask for help."

## Word-by-word
1. إِيَّاكَ | iyyāka | You alone
2. نَعْبُدُ | naʿbudu | we worship
3. وَإِيَّاكَ | wa-iyyāka | and You alone
4. نَسْتَعِينُ | nastaʿīnu | we ask for help

## Note
This is the structural pivot of the entire surah. The first three ayahs are pure praise of Allah; from ayah 5 onward, the speaker turns to direct address — "You we worship". The fronting of إِيَّاكَ (object before verb) is the grammatical signal of exclusivity ("ONLY You"). This is the heart of tawhid in the Quran.
